questions.title: Snippet BST Search Steps Trace
questions.description: What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
t = {'v': 50,
     'l': {'v': 30, 'l': None, 'r': {'v': 40, 'l': None, 'r': None}},
     'r': {'v': 70, 'l': {'v': 60, 'l': None, 'r': None}, 'r': None}}
steps = 0
n = t
x = 60
while n and n['v'] != x:
    steps += 1
    n = n['l'] if x < n['v'] else n['r']
print(steps, n['v'])
